footer.tagline: A forensic approach to a kitchen essential. Transparency is the highest form of luxury.

proof.blurb: Four independent checkpoints stand between the field and your kitchen. Each one publishes its own record.
proof.coldPressBody: Wooden kolhu extraction held below 40°C so glucosinolates and aroma survive the press.
proof.soilBody: Trace-element fingerprinting ties every litre to a specific field, not a region.
proof.ledgerBody: Harvest, press, seal, ship — each step hashed on-chain within the hour.
proof.assayBody: Independent labs measure erucic acid, peroxide value and adulterants per batch.
proof.waitlistBody: 1,400 bottles from the February harvest. Reserved first for the collective's members.

labCertificate.assayed: Assayed 12 Mar 2026 · Sundar Analytical Labs, Jaipur

provenance.title: The people behind the press.
provenance.blurb: Fourteen micro-farms in the Rajasthan mustard belt, no middlemen, 48% of revenue returned to growers.
provenance.farmerAlt: Rajinder Singh, master presser of the Pure Roots farmer collective, in Alwar district
provenance.quote: My grandfather pressed sarson in the same wooden kolhu. The only thing new is that now the world can check my work.

process.title: Eight days, four signatures.
process.blurb: Nothing is batched together, blended or backdated. The timeline for every bottle is public.
process.step1Body: Growers log the plot, date and varietal. A soil core is sent for trace-element fingerprinting.
process.step2Body: Seeds are ground slowly in a wooden kolhu, kept below 40°C so nothing volatile is lost.
process.step3Body: A third-party lab measures purity, erucic acid and peroxide value, then publishes the report.
process.step4Body: Each bottle receives a unique code and QR; the batch record is hashed and sealed on-chain.

guarantee.blurb: We would rather be audited than advertised. Every claim below maps to a record you can open, timestamped and signed.
guarantee.promise1Body: Wood-churned kachi ghani pressing. Every press logs a temperature curve you can read.
guarantee.promise2Body: One farm, one harvest window, one lot. No blending, no imported filler oil.
guarantee.promise3Body: NABL-accredited labs test erucic acid, peroxide value and adulterants per batch.
guarantee.promise4Body: If a batch you own fails our own audit, we refund it and recall the lot publicly.

testimonials.title: Trusted by cooks, auditors and growers.
testimonials.quote1: The first mustard oil I've cooked with where the pungency is a feature, not a warning. My kitchen switched entirely.
testimonials.quote2: We audit food supply chains for a living. Pure Roots is the first consumer brand whose paperwork we couldn't poke a hole in.
testimonials.quote3: Being able to show buyers my own plot on the record changed what my harvest is worth.

resultBanner.passHeadline: This batch is genuine Pure Roots.
resultBanner.passBody: Seal intact, ledger hash matches the lab assay filed at press time. Nothing about this lot has been altered since sealing.
resultBanner.pendingHeadline: This batch is sealed, assay still open.
resultBanner.pendingBody: The lot is registered and the seal is valid, but the third-party lab report has not been countersigned yet. Expect results within 48 hours.
resultBanner.failedHeadline: We cannot vouch for this bottle.
resultBanner.failedBody: The code resolves to a lot that failed audit or was never sealed by us. Do not consume. Report the seller and we will replace your bottle.
resultBanner.footerRight: Issued by Pure Roots Trust Registry
